notes.title: First draft of Sif’s route completed!
notes.notes: [p]We’re excited to share a major milestone in the development of Fallen Seeds II: the [b]first draft of Sif’s route[/b] is complete![/p][p]Sif is a gifted scientist determined to unravel the mystery of the Anomalous Zone. Her journey in the game is one of choices between cold logic and humanity (chimyanity?), between the power of science and the weight of feelings.[/p][p]In Sif’s route you’ll face political intrigue within the Research Institute, struggles of trust and betrayal, dangerous experiments, and moments of profound owl-personal catharsis. Alongside Evoid, she searches for answers that could determine the fate of an entire planet.[/p][p]This draft is the foundation for the final version of the scenario. Thank you for following our progress — there’s much more to come![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45148590/aac65576c1014cb2f6d2655a0038ca3f28aa47b4.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: The first draft of Kaya's route is complete!
notes.notes: [p]We’re excited to share that the first draft of Kaya’s route is now complete — one of the most ambitious and emotionally charged storylines in [i]Fallen Seeds II[/i].[/p][p]⠀[/p][p]Kaya is a serpent chimy and the head of security at the Institute. Beneath her cold, paranoid exterior lies a wounded soul. Her route is a journey of trust and betrayal, heroic defiance, and agonizing choices.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for following the project — your support means the world to us![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45148590/cdda2dd73be431f68cc99d36b545967b94067e3c.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: First Draft of Ada's Route Completed!
notes.notes: [p]Good news, everyone — we’ve finished the first draft of Ada’s route in Fallen Seeds II![/p][p]Ada is an enigmatic rogue and a guide through the Zone. Her story is one of resistance, grief, and hope. It’s not just a personal drama, but a philosophical stand against the Flock's conservatice society. In this route, Evod and Ada join forces to unveil the mysteries of the Zone, reach the Ship of the Wanderers, challenge the existing order, and reshape the fate of Ultar.[/p][p]We’re now moving on to editing, visual development, and voice production. Thank you for your patience and support — every step brings us closer to the release of Fallen Seeds II.[/p][p]Stay tuned and don’t forget to wishlist the game![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45148590/4f0440e5fd5a87e12c42c1b21dfc754a10f1d3fd.png"][/img][/p]
